1.consolidated_definition: Máquina que exprime la parte sólida de la muestra de caña que se obtiene directamente del vehículo que la transporta a la central.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Machine that presses the solid part of the cane sample obtained directly from the vehicle transporting it to the central processing facility.
